Model-Specific Construction

Superior Standard Features

Foundation & Floor

4×6 pressure-treated foundation beams; 16×16×4-inch solid concrete pads; 2×6 pressure-treated joists at 16 inches on center; ¾-inch pressure-treated exterior-rated plywood floor.

Walls & Exterior

2×4 kiln-dried wall studs at 16 inches on center; Roseburg DuraTemp standard siding; natural unfinished cedar trim, with available siding and finish upgrades.

Roof & Weather Protection

½-inch CDX plywood roof decking, architectural asphalt shingles and synthetic underlayment. Roof framing and ventilation are designed for the Antique Saltbox roof profile.

Doors & Windows

Traditional Craftsman-style doors and functional windows are available. Door and window styles, quantities, locations and pricing are specified in your written proposal.

Built on Site — Always

Every building is constructed on your property, never transported as a completed structure. Engineered pad spacing and anchors. Up to 6 inches of foundation leveling included; additional grading and preparation quoted in writing.

Workmanship

10-year workmanship warranty, subject to written terms. Applicable manufacturer product warranties are identified separately rather than replaced with an unsupported structural guarantee.

Frequently Asked Questions

Questions Worth Answering Before You Build

Is interior finishing included in the standard Antique Saltbox?

No. Our crew builds your weather-tight exterior shell on your property. Interior wall and ceiling finishes are not included unless separately quoted.

Is my Antique Saltbox built on my property?

Yes. Every Appalachian Sheds building is constructed on site by our crew. We do not bring a completed shed to your property.

Is the cupola included in the quoted prices?

The cupola shown is a decorative option. Ask to include it in your written proposal.

Do I have to paint or stain the building?

Exterior caulking/sealing and painting or staining must be completed within 30 days of construction as applicable to the selected materials. ASI can quote its complete painting service.

How is my final price determined?

Choose your size and siding to see the starting building price. Your written proposal will include selected options, site conditions, required preparation, finishing services, and any applicable taxes.

Can I choose different doors and windows?

Yes. We will review your preferred door style, window arrangement and decorative features as part of your written proposal. The photograph may show optional design elements.
